title: Waimea WaterFalls & Oahu Circle Island Tour with Byodo-In Temple
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Oʻahu’s must-see highlights in one unforgettable day! Visit the peaceful Byodo-In Temple, spend 90 minutes exploring Waimea Valley and its beautiful waterfall, enjoy breathtaking views from Nuʻuanu Pali Lookout, Makapuʻu Lookout, and the Halona Blowhole, stop at the iconic Chinaman’s Hat, savor a North Shore food truck lunch, sample local treats at Tropical Farms and a Kahuku Fruit Stand, and finish with a visit to the world-famous Dole Plantation. With included admissions, small groups, and knowledgeable local guides, you’ll experience the very best of Oʻahu without feeling rushed.
